items.observation: The column is Uint32 in the FFI (bindings.dart:76-79). `_validateCell` rejects a column only above 0xFFFFFFFF; the shim narrows the column unchecked to `(lxw_col_t)` = uint16. Columns between 65536 and 2^32-1 wrap modulo 65536, pass libxlsxwriter's bound check, and the data is silently written to the wrong column. This is exactly the failure class the `_maxCellIndex` comment (workbook.dart:233-241) wants to prevent. The tests only try values above 2^32 (test/xlsxwriter_test.dart:521-522). Proven by code reading, not executed.
items.proposed_fix: A separate upper bound for the column (0xFFFF; libxlsxwriter keeps reporting the Excel limit with its own error), in all column paths including setColumn. A `writeNumber(0, 0x10003, 1)` throwsArgumentError test and a CHANGELOG entry.
items.closure_criteria: Every column path, including setColumn, rejects columns above 0xFFFF before the native call. A writeNumber(0, 0x10003, 1) test expects ArgumentError and CHANGELOG.md records the fix.

items.observation: setColumn and setRow skip `_validateCell`. There is only a `< 0` check; setColumn throws an `ArgumentError(message)` without a name. There is no upper bound and no `firstCol <= lastCol` check; a row or column above 2^32 wraps in the FFI.
items.proposed_fix: Row and column validation helpers + `ArgumentError.value`; a range-order check; a test.
items.closure_criteria: setColumn and setRow validate bounds through shared helpers that throw ArgumentError.value and reject firstCol greater than lastCol. A test covers the out-of-range and reversed-range cases.

items.observation: The dartdoc of addTable and insertChart promises a RangeError for coordinate errors; `_validateCell` throws ArgumentError.value (not RangeError).
items.closure_criteria: The addTable and insertChart dartdoc names ArgumentError for coordinate errors, matching what _validateCell throws.

items.observation: toBytes does not close the workbook when `build` throws; the native memory is left to the finalizer and the temporary directory is still deleted.
items.proposed_fix: Free without writing on the error path (detach + native free) and a 'build throws' test.
items.closure_criteria: toBytes detaches the finalizer and frees the workbook without writing when build throws. A test forces build to throw and covers the error path.

items.observation: The NUL check + toNativeUtf8 + try/finally malloc.free skeleton is written 17 times.
items.proposed_fix: A `_withCString(String value, String name, void Function(Pointer<Utf8>))` helper that also contains the NUL check.
items.closure_criteria: All native string sites route through a single _withCString helper that performs the NUL check and the try/finally malloc.free.

items.observation: The Format enums mirror libxlsxwriter enum values and there is no test pinning them against the header. Every public enum exposes the native value through `.value`.
items.proposed_fix: A header-pinning test for the mirrored values. `.value` stays to avoid a breaking change; new enums use a shim identity.
items.closure_criteria: A test pins every mirrored Format enum value against the vendored libxlsxwriter header. The .value getter remains and new enums use shim identities.
